entries.title: Fewer pauses with a long task history
entries.body: With thousands of tasks on record, the window no longer stops for a quarter of a second while your first mate lists tasks or starts several crewmates at once. Each list, card and background check now reads a task once instead of again for every neighbour that names it.
entries.noPicture: This removes pauses in the window's response; nothing on screen looks different.
